titles.native: 福生ダンシングアニメーション

description:
"This work was produced at a workshop where you can experience the animation created using a technique called rotoscoping up close at the event "Ginza Shoeikai Art Festival" held in Fussa, Tokyo in June 2014. We asked the visitors to draw each one by hand, and joined them together to complete the work."

(Source: Official YouTube Upload, translated)
